The '''Corrupted Bear''' is a mini-boss monster found in the [[The Gauntlet#Corrupted Gauntlet|Corrupted Gauntlet]] that attacks with [[Melee]]. Their counterpart in the [[The Gauntlet|Gauntlet]] is the [[Crystalline Bear]]. Mini-boss monsters always spawn alone and only appear at the edges of the Gauntlet map.
